description: Screenshot one public web page in a headless browser: desktop (1440x900) or mobile (390x844) viewport, PNG or JPEG, returned as an image. Viewport only, no logins or scripts; follows robots.txt and does not get past bot walls; at most one screenshot every 10 seconds across all callers. Paid only: $0.01 USDC per page. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page.

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.
